dimensional weight

https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.

Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.

Combined shipping

The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.

For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

description:
*Up for auction is a unique lot of two vintage gold charms featuring distinctive institutional and fraternal designs:
Smithsonian Sunburst Charm: Crafted with an arched sunburst motif over a rectangular base marked "Smithsonian". It features a small accent stone set in the lower section (unverified, likely a small diamond or crystal). The reverse is stamped "14K L". Measures approximately 1 inch long by 0.5 inches wide.
The sunburst design on the Smithsonian charm represents the official seal and iconic logo of the Smithsonian Institution. The "sunburst" or "starburst" motif has long been the primary symbol of the Smithsonian. It was formally adapted as the institution's official logo to represent the "increase and diffusion of knowledge", symbolizing light, discovery, and enlightenment.
1947 Job’s Daughters (IJD) Fratertral Honor Key Charm: A vintage 1947 Masonic-affiliated Job’s Daughters key charm featuring a diamond-shaped black enamel center with compass directions (N, S, E, W) and the Greek letters. The back is hand-engraved with "E", initials "I.J.D.", and the class year "'47". Measures approximately 1.25 inches long by 0.5 inches wide. It is unmarked for gold.
IJD stands for International Order of Job's Daughters (a Masonic-affiliated youth organization for young women). The compass points (N, S, E, W) represent the officer positions/directions, while the center displays the Greek letters (Sigma Gamma Epsilon), standing for the motto “Service, Grace, and Excellence” or the organization's emblem. The triangles represent the three Daughters of Job.
Both pieces are in very good vintage condition with minor surface wear appropriate for their age.
Please review all photos carefully for detail.

Smithsonian 14K Gold Sun Charm: $70 - $110
1947 Job’s Daughters (IJD) Honor Key Charm: $55 - $75

This commemorative set features authentic segments including a piece of the Berlin Wall, preserved following the historic events of late 1989. The lot includes the original presentation box, a velvet drawstring pouch, an informative historical booklet, and a formal Declaration of Origin document. These artifacts represent a significant turning point in 20th-century history, documenting the transition from the Cold War to German reunification.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Berlin Wall Segment
- Authentic concrete cut with visible aggregate, originated in East Germany
2.
Lava Rock Piece
- Naturally textured specimen as identified in collection records
3.
Documentation
- Original 1989 Declaration of Origin and historical booklet
4.
Presentation Materials
- Original Hyman Products box and burgundy velvet drawstring pouch
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. Rock specimens are intact with natural textures. Documentation and booklet are well-preserved with minor age-toning. The original cardboard box shows light shelf wear and a partial surface tear near the barcode area. Velvet pouch is clean and functional.

description:
Vintage Japanese butane lighters featuring a pipe-themed design and a textured gold-tone finish. These collectible lighters showcase classic mid-century styling and adjustable flame settings.
Includes two vintage lighters made in Japan.
One lighter features a black finish with a gold-tone pipe graphic.
One lighter features a textured gold-tone finish with a crown logo.
Both lighters include adjustable flame height controls on the base.
Weight: 3.447 grams (as shown on scale).
Condition:
These are pre-owned vintage lighters. The black lighter shows surface wear and minor scratches on the finish. The gold-tone lighter shows light surface wear consistent with age. Please see photos for details.

Gold filled lighters. Untested. Sold as-is.
